parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$\mathbf{u} = \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ 2 \\ 6 \end{pmatrix} \mathbf{v} = \begin{pmatrix} 8 \\ -1 \\ -7 \end{pmatrix} \mathbf{u}.\mathbf{v} = -2 - 42$ M1 (Correct method for scalar product)
$|\mathbf{u}| \times |\mathbf{v}| = \sqrt{2^2 + 6^2} \times \sqrt{8^2 + 1^2 + 7^2}$ M1 (Prod of mods. At least one methodically correct.)
$\cos \theta = \frac{-44}{\sqrt{40} \times \sqrt{114}} = \frac{-44}{4\sqrt{285}} = \frac{-4}{\sqrt{11}}$ M1 (All linked correctly and inverse cos used correctly)
$\theta = 130.7^{\circ}$ or $2.28(05)$ rads A1 (No other angles between 0° and 180°)
